sources.summary: During World Space Week, architecture expands its boundaries. The new space race raises a fundamental question for today's designers: how do we imagine, build, and inhabit beyond Earth? From October 5 to 8, 2026, the Faculty of Architecture, Design and Urbanism at the University of Buenos Aires will host Space Architecture Week, a Latin American gathering that will bring together architecture, science, technology, and design. Through workshops, a space architecture hackathon, international guests, talks, interviews, and exhibitions, students, professionals, and specialists will explore new ways to inhabit the Moon, Mars, and other environments.
